title: Prototyping Engineer – Hardware Lab (m/f/d)
description:
Build the first versions of our next sensor generation.

What you'll do
- Assemble and test prototype boards and housings
- Design 3D-printed fixtures and enclosures
- Document tests and report findings to the development team

What you bring
- Degree in mechatronics, electrical or mechanical engineering
- Up to 3 years of experience in lab or prototype work
- Work authorisation for Germany or the EU is required; we offer visa sponsorship and relocation support for the right candidate
- English; basic German is helpful
